As the game entered its closing stages, tempers flared, resulting in yellow cards for Guillermo Maripan and Paul Mendy due to a scuffle in the 82nd minute. matches.description: Watch Cagliari vs Udinese highlights and goals from Serie A on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 9, 2026. Cagliari and Udinese faced off in a crucial Serie A fixture on May 9, 2026, with both sides desperate to secure a defining result in the latter stages of the season. The atmosphere at the stadium was electric as the hosts looked to leverage their home advantage against a resilient visiting side. Early Pressure and VAR Intervention Cagliari dominated the opening exchanges, maintaining a staggering 62% of possession throughout the contest. Early attempts from outside the box by Juan Rodriguez and Michael Folorunsho signaled their intent, though neither could find the target. The match took a dramatic turn in the 33rd minute when the referee paused play for a lengthy VAR check regarding a potential penalty for the home side. Much to the frustration of the home crowd, the initial call stood, and no penalty was awarded, leaving the match scoreless as both teams headed into the tunnels at halftime. Clinical Counter and Defensive Heroics Shortly after the restart, Cagliari nearly took the lead when Sebastiano Esposito saw his goal-bound effort heroically hacked off the line by the Udinese defense. However, the momentum shifted in the 56th minute when the visitors struck against the run of play. A brilliant key pass from Oumar Solet released Hassane Kamara , who provided a pinpoint assist for Adam Buksa to tap home from close range. The goal forced Cagliari into a tactical reshuffle, bringing on veteran Andrea Belotti to bolster their attacking options. Stoppage Time Drama Seals the Win The closing stages were characterized by desperate Cagliari pressure and spectacular defending from Udinese . Alberto Dossena had a shot cleared off the line in the 76th minute, and Paul Mendy even attempted an audacious bicycle kick that flew wide. Despite the relentless onslaught, Udinese remained organized and struck a final blow in the 6th minute of stoppage time. Keinan Davis turned provider, setting up substitute Idrissa Gueye for a simple finish to double the lead. Led by a Man of the Match performance from Oumar Solet , the visitors navigated the final moments to secure a hard-fought away victory.

A Gritty Conclusion As the match entered its final stages, the intensity remained high despite the lack of a clinical finish. A late booking for Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu in the 84th minute highlighted the competitive edge that persisted until the final whistle. Grimsby Town introduced Shilow Tracey and Adrien Thibaut in the closing minutes to test the weary Cambridge United backline, but clear-cut openings remained elusive.
